## Player outcome

Who is playing, where are they, and what should they be able to do or recognize? Describe what happens on the current build. Link the milestone, relevant design brief, and any playtest finding.

## Smallest playable change

Describe the action, the in-world cue or prompt, and the feedback on each screen. Name the existing place, equipment, or rule this builds on. List any bigger decisions this issue leaves open.

## Crew roles and saved progress

How does one player finish? What can the partner do that makes it easier or more enjoyable? Identify anything the crew shares, anything personal, and what should survive reconnect or a host restart.

## Acceptance playtest

- [ ] From this starting location, build and save state: …
- [ ] As a solo player, take this action and observe: …
- [ ] As a pair, split these roles and check this result on each screen: …
- [ ] Try the most revealing edge case (e.g. simultaneous hand-in, nightfall, a late join, or a restart) and check: …

## Evidence for review

Provide a reproducible route, Workbench link, before/after view or test result that demonstrates the outcome. Link the mechanic spec to update when this becomes playable.
